# single.estimate_single_trial_from_dataset { #fmrimod.single.estimate_single_trial_from_dataset }

```python
estimate_single_trial_from_dataset(
    dataset,
    spec,
    *,
    method='lss',
    confounds=None,
    return_se=False,
    block=None,
    durations=None,
    precision=None,
    prewhiten=None,
    nuisance_projector=None,
    chunk_size=None,
    oasis_config=None,
    sbhm_config=None,
    sbhm_library=None,
    include_intercept=False,
    n_basis=None,
)
```

Estimate per-trial betas from an FmriDataset and trialwise spec.

This public-seam wrapper consumes a
`FmriDataset` plus a specification containing a
`trialwise` construction. It builds the trial design matrix
from the specification and dataset events, then delegates to
`estimate_single_trial`.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name               | Type                                                | Description                                                                                                                                                                                         | Default    |
|--------------------|-----------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| dataset            | FmriDataset                                         | Typed dataset carrying time-series data and an event table.                                                                                                                                         | _required_ |
| spec               | str, sequence of formula Term, or EventModelBuilder | Trialwise definition accepted by `fmrimod.event_model`, such as ``"trialwise()"`` or ``"trialwise(add_sum=True)"``. Typed `Spec` trees are not accepted by this wrapper. | _required_ |
| method             | SingleTrialMethod or literal string                 | Estimator selector; see `estimate_single_trial`.                                                                                                                                              | `'lss'`    |
| confounds          | NDArray                                             | Nuisance regressors with one row per time point.                                                                                                                                                    | `None`     |
| return_se          | bool                                                | Request standard errors from estimators that support them.                                                                                                                                          | `False`    |
| block              | object                                              | Run assignment forwarded to `fmrimod.event_model`. When omitted, the wrapper uses the event table's ``run`` or ``block`` column, then falls back to a single run.                             | `None`     |
| durations          | object                                              | Duration specification forwarded to `fmrimod.event_model`. Defaults to the event table's ``duration`` column when present.                                                                    | `None`     |
| precision          | float                                               | Absolute convolution-grid step forwarded to `fmrimod.event_model`.                                                                                                                            | `None`     |
| prewhiten          | PrewhitenConfig                                     | AR prewhitening configuration forwarded to `estimate_single_trial`.                                                                                                                           | `None`     |
| nuisance_projector | NuisanceProjector                                   | Precomputed nuisance projector for LSS estimation.                                                                                                                                                  | `None`     |
| chunk_size         | int                                                 | Voxel chunk size for LSS beta-only solves.                                                                                                                                                          | `None`     |
| oasis_config       | OasisConfig                                         | OASIS estimator configuration.                                                                                                                                                                      | `None`     |
| sbhm_config        | SbhmConfig                                          | SBHM pipeline configuration.                                                                                                                                                                        | `None`     |
| sbhm_library       | SbhmLibrary                                         | Pre-built SBHM library required by the SBHM method.                                                                                                                                                 | `None`     |
| include_intercept  | bool                                                | Add an intercept to the LSS or LSA adjustment design.                                                                                                                                               | `False`    |
| n_basis            | int                                                 | HRF basis dimension forwarded to `estimate_single_trial`. Normally omit it: the wrapper infers the dimension from the compiled ``trialwise`` design.                                          | `None`     |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type              | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
|--------|-------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | SingleTrialResult | Carries ``trial_labels`` derived from the trialwise term column names plus dataset-derived metadata: ``trial_table`` (the events slice aligned with ``betas`` rows), ``run_labels`` (per-trial block/run id when the events table carries one), ``subject_id`` (when the dataset advertises one), and ``spatial_descriptor`` (the capability label describing the voxel space the betas live in). Matrix-first `estimate_single_trial` callers continue to leave all four metadata fields ``None``. |
